hypothesis: Taleb-style empirical tail shape, implied tail pricing, and nonlinear leveraged-ETF fragility improve tail-label learnability and direct allocation

taleb_feature_definitions.soxx_tail_xi_504: rolling 504d lower-tail Hill xi using the largest 10% losses
taleb_feature_definitions.soxx_tail_xi_instability: absolute disagreement between rolling 252d and 756d Hill xi
taleb_feature_definitions.soxx_es_var_ratio_504: rolling 504d absolute expected-shortfall to VaR ratio at 5%
taleb_feature_definitions.soxx_tail_loss_concentration_252: five largest rolling 252d SOXX losses divided by all losses
taleb_feature_definitions.soxx_exceedance_intensity_60: rolling 60d frequency below the lagged rolling 252d 5% quantile
taleb_feature_definitions.soxx_downside_semivariance_share_20: rolling 20d negative squared returns divided by total squared returns
taleb_feature_definitions.soxx_jump_ratio_20: rolling 20d non-negative daily RV minus bipower variation share
taleb_feature_definitions.vix9d_vix3m_z_126: rolling 126d z-score of VIX9D divided by VIX3M
taleb_feature_definitions.vvix_vix_z_126: rolling 126d z-score of VVIX divided by VIX
taleb_feature_definitions.tail_risk_premium_9d: VIX9D annualized variance minus rolling 9d SOXX realized variance
taleb_feature_definitions.soxl_fragility_curvature_504: rolling downside loss acceleration across 0-1, 1-2, and >2 sigma SOXX shock buckets
taleb_feature_definitions.soxl_downside_beta_gap_252: rolling 252d SOXL beta on negative SOXX days minus unconditional beta
taleb_feature_definitions.soxx_rebalance_drag_pressure_20: 3 times rolling 20d SOXX squared-return sum, the 3x path drag proxy
taleb_feature_definitions.soxl_levered_decay_acceleration_5: five-day change in rolling 20d SOXL return minus 3x SOXX return

labels.tail_5d: future SOXL adverse 5d <= -12% or SOXX adverse 5d <= -6%
labels.relative_alpha: risk-adjusted 5d/20d SOXL utility exceeds SOXX by 2%
labels.recovery: known stress context and future SOXX 5d >= 4% with adverse path >= -4%
